name: Clean Tech
description: A calm, bright product-explainer look: cool off-white with a drifting dot grid, crisp Inter Tight words that rise into place, white UI cards with soft shadows, one electric blue accent, mono labels and a green check for anything finished.
style: Kinetic type on cool off-white: short statements rise word by word, the key word gets a blue pill, and ideas become small working diagrams — a prompt card that types and sends, nodes that pop in, a dot that travels a loop, task rows that tick off, a counter that climbs.
